title: Neon Text Do’s and Don’ts
slide_intent: Reserve a conspicuous effect for selected words so the reader knows which phrase matters most.
strategic_value: Selective neon emphasis can connect T-Mobile messaging to its network visual language without overwhelming the words.
demonstration: Two approved examples contrast with an excessive glow and a fully neon message.
practical_value: Apply neon to the selected phrase, then check that its glow leaves letter shapes clear.

content_islands.name: Treatment purpose
content_islands.spec: Place the title and short emphasis rule at left.

content_islands.name: Approved treatments
content_islands.spec: Stack two green-check examples in the middle column with captions.

content_islands.name: Rejected treatments
content_islands.spec: Stack excessive glow and all-neon examples in the right column.

ingredient.name: Neon text
ingredient.role: Direct attention to a selected phrase.
ingredient.application: Apply glow to select words, retain readable letterforms and size supporting text relative to existing lockups.
ingredient.scope: Special emphasis within messages; do not render an entire message in neon.
